description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

ACT is hiring an entry-level Infrastructure Engineer I to help build, automate, and support cloud-native infrastructure across its AWS environment. The role works under senior engineers to support infrastructure operations, automated deployments, backup and monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Entry-level cloud infrastructure engineer automating AWS backup, monitoring, provisioning, patching, and recovery operations

Responsibilities:
• Monitor backup jobs across ACT's AWS environment using cloud-native and enterprise backup platforms (e.g., CommVault, AWS Backup), applying AI-assisted tools to help investigate and resolve failures
• Maintain backup schedules, retention policies, and restore procedures; support recovery requests and audits
• Assist with deploying, configuring, and maintaining monitoring and observability tooling; partner with the monitoring tool administration team on agent health and coverage
• Triage and respond to monitoring alerts routed through ITSM tools, using AI-assisted diagnostics, resolve routine incidents and escalate more complex incidents appropriately
• Support AWS-native infrastructure management, monitoring, backup, recovery, and automation activities; maintain awareness of Azure concepts where limited hybrid-cloud support is needed
• Assist with building and provisioning cloud infrastructure with Terraform, Ansible, and automated CI/CD pipelines, replacing manual, ticket-driven build processes
• Support and help investigate patching cycles through automated pipelines and scripts to minimize manual patch-weekend effort
• Support administration of underlying Windows Server and Linux systems supporting cloud workloads, including patching, service troubleshooting, log review, filesystem/storage management, access support, and routine health checks
• Maintain, and with guidance, develop reusable Infrastructure as Code modules, automation scripts, and runbooks for common server, storage, backup, and monitoring tasks
• Apply AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate infrastructure automation development, troubleshooting, diagnostics, and documentation
• Identify recurring issues, manual toil, and gaps in current infrastructure, deployment, and patching processes; recommend automation, AI-assisted tooling, or pipeline improvements
• Research and evaluate new tools and automation approaches, with senior engineer guidance, for backup, monitoring, and server management, recommending adoption where they improve reliability or reduce manual effort
• Document standard operating procedures and contribute to the team's knowledge base as processes are automated
• Learn ACT's cloud infrastructure, storage, backup, and monitoring environment, tools, and standard procedures
• Complete a first automated server build and a first automated patch cycle under guidance from the DevOps/Platform team
• Begin independently triaging routine ITSM alerts and investigating backup failures
• Make initial contributions to cloud infrastructure, storage, backup, and monitoring operations as automation coverage expands
• Progress toward broader engineering participation in AWS infrastructure, automation, platform tooling, and operational improvement beyond day-to-day server support

Requirements:
• Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship
• Foundational knowledge of infrastructure, systems administration, technical support, networking, scripting, automation or cloud technologies
• Experience using or developing scripts with languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies
• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code concepts and tools such as Terraform, Ansible or automation technologies
• Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts such as compute, storage, networking, security, monitoring, backup, and automation
• Exposure to Windows Server and Linux operating systems and their administration, support or troubleshooting
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a related field. Or an equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired
• Basic understanding of backup and recovery concepts, server monitoring, and patch management
• Ability to learn and apply new technologies quickly, including AI-assisted engineering tools that support automation, scripting and operational efficiency
• Willingness and interest in learning, taking initiative and drive to dig deep into problems and think sideways when creative solutions are needed
• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the discipline to follow runbooks and escalate appropriately
• Ability to learn new automation tools and AI-assisted engineering practices quickly and apply them to daily work
• Ability to troubleshoot server and cloud infrastructure issues involving performance, storage, network connectivity, access, monitoring, backup, and operating system services
• Familiarity with tools such as PowerShell, Bash, systemd, Windows Event Viewer, package managers, configuration management, and operational runbooks
• Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively with senior engineers and vendors
• Ability to work on standard tasks independently or as part of a larger team on more complex projects
• Ability to work occasional off-hour shifts to support monthly patching weekends

Preferred:
• Experience with AWS
• Experience with CommVault, AWS Backup, or another enterprise backup platform
• Hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure services such as EC2, S3, EBS, IAM, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, AWS Backup, VPC, and related automation tooling
• Experience with Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or similar Infrastructure as Code tools for provisioning and maintaining cloud and server infrastructure
• Experience administering enterprise Windows Server and Linux environments, including Active Directory/Group Policy awareness, DNS, PowerShell, shell scripting, vulnerability remediation, virtualization, and automated configuration management
• Experience supporting server, storage, or backup operations in a complex enterprise environment
